entities.summary: Iosif Iraklievich Gusakovsky was a Soviet military leader during World War II who was twice awarded the title Hero of the Soviet Union during World War II for his command of the 44th Guards Tank Brigade. He remained in the military after the war and in 1968 became a General of the Army.
